notes.n1-legacy-codec: Q-N1 ruled (D-20261103-CMA CM-NAMES (1)): the Legacy codec is OG's legacy-title-parsing, one decodeURIComponent over the whole stem, kept undecoded when any escape is malformed ("50%25 of 100%", "%E9"). notes.n2-triple-lowbar-codec: Q-N1 ruled (D-20261103-CMA CM-NAMES (1)): malformed escapes and empty namespace parts now get OG's name ("%E9", "bad%E9", "lead", "trail", "x/y").
